basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old tech enthusiast from Seattle with a passion for gaming and anime. I work as a software developer, which keeps me busy during the day, but I always make time to unwind with some gaming or anime in the evenings. I love discussing the latest in technology and I'm a big fan of CaptainSparklez. I'm currently single, enjoy exploring new subreddits, and I'm always on the lookout for interesting discussions. I typically browse Reddit during my breaks at work and late at night.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and self-taught skills acquired through online courses and personal projects. I keep up with tech trends through forums, podcasts, and YouTube channels.
